articles.title: Sugar prices may fall soon as 3-3.5 lakh tonnes of refined sugar is expected to enter Indian market
articles.description: Refined sugar stocks are entering the domestic market, helping ease supply concerns, while duty-free imports of raw sugar are expected to further strengthen availability ahead of the festive season. Consumers can therefore expect sugar prices to become more reasonable in the coming days.

articles.title: Weak monsoon, West Asia risks cloud July-Sept FMCG demand
articles.description: Consumer goods demand faces challenges from a weak monsoon and rising inflation. FMCG volumes saw a slight slowdown in the recent quarter, signaling potential future impacts. While urban growth eased, rural expansion accelerated but faces monsoon uncertainties. Companies remain cautiously optimistic about demand resilience despite ongoing global concerns. The full effect of delayed rainfall on rural spending is expected this quarter.

articles.title: Kedaara pumps $200m into ortho support wear maker Tynor
articles.description: Kedaara Capital has acquired a majority stake in Tynor Orthotics for approximately $200 million. This significant deal provides an exit for investor Lighthouse Funds from the medical device maker. Tynor Orthotics manufactures orthopaedic supports and mobility aids for global markets. The company has an extensive distribution network reaching numerous retail outlets and hospitals. Kedaara will partner with Tynor's promoters and its existing strategic partner Thuasne.
